primary: Native Resolved, original trusted verify_task + TaskResult/JUnit agreement
factor: Only System instruction strategy replacement; YAML/model/tools/generation/budgets identical
ranking: SHA256('U-RE-V04-EGR-REPLICATION:17:'+instance_id), ascending; instance_id tie-break; no difficulty/result selection
selection: First two BASELINE_ELIGIBLE in frozen order; stop at two. At finite pool exhaustion report insufficient; never refill with development/reserved tasks.
identity_gate: Before screening, bind original snapshot/base/overlay/task-record/wheels/Verifier SHA; compare snapshot bytes with all excluded129 identities and between prospective candidates. Unknown source or alias conflict STOP; do not silently replace.
admission: Original empty Agent patch, no Prompt/Gemma; original native verifier executes, Issue-related ordinary behavioral failure, zero independent environment errors, original source and provenance, TaskResult/JUnit consistency, complete cleanup.
reject_continue: Known independent dependency/fixture deficiency with established cause
conditional: Target-caused collection failure remains CONDITIONALLY_ELIGIBLE only; not counted among two formal tasks without separate validation.
independence: Fresh session/history/chroot/workspace/UID lifecycle/patch/logs/trusted verifier per run. No previous candidate output or evaluator-only content enters Agent.

secondary_metrics.first_supported_behavior_edit: Operation-end upper bound of actual target production hash change, retrospectively linked to prior normal Issue/source/test evidence. Unknown support -> null; imports/debug/scratch excluded.
secondary_metrics.repair_hypotheses: Explicit falsifiable normal-input hypothesis plus expected discriminating observation. Human review with tool/model event hashes; earliest occurrence null unless all preceding events reviewed.
secondary_metrics.repeated_search: Same command/result/source epoch; potential utility assessed separately. Do not label every repeated token/search useless.
secondary_metrics.broad_tests: Unscoped full-suite invocation without concrete regression justification; explicit paths and actual scope retained privately.
secondary_metrics.path_and_dependency_errors: Count actual failed tool actions; distinguish expected first discovery from avoidable repetition and trusted native errors.
secondary_metrics.cost: Actual charged tools, Agent/Worker wall seconds, received prompt/completion tokens including failures; missing usage null plus coverage count.
secondary_metrics.context: Actual guard time/input, repair/submission state at guard, native resolved separately.
secondary_metrics.submission: Explicit successful tool response, repeated successful submits, tools after first success; native resolved is independent.
secondary_metrics.patch: Observed applicable patch and production hash; nonempty is not correctness. Native verifier is primary.
